setup.zh: 雨小了。渡叔的船还横在滩上，一半泡在水里。天快亮了。
setup.en: The rain eases. Du Shu's boat still lies across the shingle, half in the water. Dawn is close.

recap.zh: 渡叔送你上山：去沉鼎观的山路，从渡口往北。
recap.en: Du Shu saw you off: the path to Chending Temple runs north from the crossing.

text.zh: 去沉鼎观的山路，从渡口往北。
text.en: The path to Chending Temple runs north from the crossing.

label.en: Up the mountain · To the temple

exits.means: sets off up the mountain to the temple, or moves on

text.zh: 你背起包袱，回头看了一眼。渡叔的灯还亮着。
text.en: You shoulder your bundle and look back once. Du Shu's lantern is still lit.
